<!-- pr-reviewer: e24f6bacfe9ea50ee11c04a98c540c08f8985b5b -->
**Verdict: needs changes before merge** — one mechanical body fix. No code findings. The tree is MERGEABLE and the build is green.

What looks good:
- The fix removes the two fixed paths (`rough-only` and `right-only`) in the system temp folder. Both posts now target a `tempfile::tempdir()` folder, kept alive for the scope of the test. The tempdir binding holds the folder until end of test.
- The pattern matches line 337 of the same file.
- Nothing changed under test. No golden changed. No dependency added: `tempfile` was already a dev-dependency.
- The trial merge with current `origin/main` (c79c9b24f) is clean. `MERGEABLE`, `CLEAN` at the head.

Results (local build, trial-merged worktree, -j 6, sccache):
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test wire_post`: 37 passed, 0 failed (24.2 s). Both pinning tests pass: `an_open_run_with_a_skim_generates_verifies_and_posts` and `a_centre_slit_with_a_skim_generates_verifies_and_posts`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean (0 warnings).

Targeted tests:
- No post or toolpath change. No example catalog run.
- Light lane not run: no code under test changed (same as the PR body). Not a pass.
- No heavy step: this is a test-only PR. No wrong-output path. No heavy finding.
- `<!-- heavy-wave: ... -->` record: none. Absence is not a finding.

Requested before merge (numbered, one finding):
1. The body must end with `Fixes #4405` to close the issue this PR addresses. The body ends with `Refs #4400` for the rolling red issue. Fix is one line, mechanical, body-only. Keep `Refs #4400` for the rolling red issue (this PR does not fix it).

Questions / notes (not blocking):
- The linked issue #4405 and the PR carry the `P1` label. A test-path fix on a shared runner is a nuisance, not wrong output. Consider the priority label.
- PR #4400 (the rolling red post-merge gate) is not fixed by this PR. The body says so. Correct as written.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: e24f6bacfe9ea50ee11c04a98c540c08f8985b5b -->
**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge** — clean re-review at the same head, no code blockers.

What changed since the 18:33Z review: the PR body only. One line added at the end, `Fixes #4431`; `Refs #4400` kept. The head is unchanged (`e24f6bacfe9ea50ee11c04a98c540c08f8985b5b`). The code, the diff and the pinning tests are the same as the tree the 18:33Z review read.

Body reading, explicit: the body ends `Refs #4400` + `Fixes #4431`. This is the maintainer's decision (NeoTech comment of 2026-11-27, "Body-only change by the coordinator"), and it is correct. #4431 is the open red-main issue for the two `wire_post` tests that this PR fixes (`a_centre_slit_with_a_skim_generates_verifies_and_posts` and `an_open_run_with_a_skim_generates_verifies_and_posts`, runs 46058127364 / 46065396255). #4400 is closed and tracks the slow `example_catalog` tests and the runner clippy fault. This PR does not fix #4400, so `Refs #4400` is correct and `Fixes #4400` would be wrong. The earlier body finding (`Fixes #4405`, the PR itself) was withdrawn by the maintainer and is not repeated here.

What looks good:
- Both `rough-only` and `right-only` posts now write into a `tempfile::tempdir()` folder kept alive for the test scope (`crates/app/tests/wire_post.rs:638-639` and `:701-702`). The pattern matches line 337 of the same file.
- No other test path changed; nothing under test changed; no golden changed; no dependency added (`tempfile` was already a dev-dependency).

Results (self-hosted runner, pr-test.yml, run https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/46075628477; main `1cf7390dc0acc3248f8e98a6612d6fe6c6001a74`):
- Trial merge with main: clean — 1 file differs.
- Quick gate on the merged tree: `app wire_post (2 fn)` — ok in 148 s, 1 step, 0 failed, 0 stalled. Both pinning tests pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean (job conclusion success).

Targeted tests:
- No post or toolpath code changed — no example catalog suites owed.
- Light lane: not run. No code under test changed (test-only diff), same as the PR body and the 18:33Z review. Not a pass.
- No heavy step: this is a test-only PR. No wrong-output path; not under the safety floor.
- `<!-- heavy-wave: ... -->` record: none. Absence is not a finding.

Requested before merge: none.

Questions / notes (not blocking):
- `crates/app/tests/machine_edit.rs:251` uses a fixed folder name. The PR body records it as out of scope; the test only computes a path and writes no file. Not a finding here.
- The `P1` label is inherited from #4431, the red-main issue. Consider whether the label fits a test-path fix; the maintainer can decide.
- Labels: `needs-rework` was removed and `merge-ready` set in the same step, because this re-review is clean at the head. The prior `needs-rework` was for the withdrawn body finding.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
